# Overrool: Grounded Adversarial Legal Intelligence & Document Understanding

> Understand the contract before you sign it. Know the law before you argue it.

Overrool (https://overrool.pages.dev/) is an open-access, zero-data-leak legal intelligence engine that translates complex legal agreements into plain language, audits hidden contractual risks, performs redline version comparisons, answers questions strictly anchored in submitted documents, and simulates adversarial courtroom hearings grounded in 59 binding landmark precedents across 7 international jurisdictions.

## Core Capabilities

- **Plain-Language Document Translation**: Deconstructs complex legalese (indemnity clauses, liquidated damages, termination rights, choice of forum) into plain English summaries with an anchored glossary.
- **Contractual Risk & Obligation Audit**: Identifies one-sided liabilities, uncapped liabilities, automatic renewal traps, IP assignment overreach, and non-compete enforceability issues.
- **Redline Version Comparison**: Compares two versions of an agreement (Version A vs Version B) and explains clause modifications, risk shifts, and legal implications for each party.
- **Document-Grounded Q&A**: Answers queries strictly using text present within the uploaded document (PDF, DOCX, TXT) — preventing hallucinated facts or citations.
- **Pre-Counsel Preparation Pack**: Generates structured tactical briefs, core legal questions, and evidence checklists for consultations with qualified attorneys.
- **Adversarial Courtroom Simulation**: Simulates multi-turn oral arguments before an AI judicial bench across 59 real supreme court and appellate judgments with verified citation enforcement.

## Corpus & Jurisdictions (59 Grounded Landmark Judgments)

Overrool grounds all citations against an immutable, verified corpus of published judgments:
1. **United States (US)**: Miranda v. Arizona (384 U.S. 436), Brady v. Maryland (373 U.S. 83), Chevron U.S.A. v. NRDC (467 U.S. 837), New York Times Co. v. Sullivan (376 U.S. 254), Marbury v. Madison (5 U.S. 137), Brown v. Board of Education (347 U.S. 483), Gideon v. Wainwright (372 U.S. 335), Daubert v. Merrell Dow Pharmaceuticals (509 U.S. 579), etc.
2. **United Kingdom (UK)**: Donoghue v. Stevenson ([1932] AC 562), Carlill v. Carbolic Smoke Ball Co ([1893] 1 QB 256), Hadley v. Baxendale ([1854] 9 Exch 341), Entick v. Carrington ([1765] EWHC KB J98), R v. R ([1991] UKHL 12), Caparo Industries plc v. Dickman ([1990] UKHL 2), etc.
3. **European Union (EU)**: Van Gend en Loos (Case 26/62), Costa v. ENEL (Case 6/64), Google Spain (Case C-131/12), Schrems I (Case C-362/14), Schrems II (Case C-311/18), Cassis de Dijon (Case 120/78), etc.
4. **India (IN)**: Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala ((1973) 4 SCC 225), Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India ((1978) 1 SCC 248), K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India ((2017) 10 SCC 1), Olga Tellis v. Bombay Municipal Corp ((1985) 3 SCC 545), Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan ((1997) 6 SCC 241), etc.
5. **Canada (CA)**: R v. Oakes ([1986] 1 SCR 103), R v. Jordan ([2016] 1 SCR 631), Roncarelli v. Duplessis ([1959] SCR 121), Edwards v. Canada (Persons Case, [1930] AC 124), etc.
6. **Australia (AU)**: Mabo v. Queensland (No 2) ((1992) 175 CLR 1), Commonwealth v. Tasmania (Tasmanian Dam Case, (1983) 158 CLR 1), Australian Capital Television v. Commonwealth ((1992) 177 CLR 106), etc.
7. **South Africa (ZA)**: S v. Makwanyane (1995 (3) SA 391 (CC)), Government of the RSA v. Grootboom (2001 (1) SA 46 (CC)), Minister of Health v. TAC (2002 (5) SA 721 (CC)), etc.

## Zero Data Leak & Privacy Architecture

- **Client-Side Document Parsing**: PDF, DOCX, and TXT parsing runs entirely inside the user's browser using Web Workers and WebAssembly. No document text is uploaded to external processing servers.
- **Direct BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)**: Direct client-to-provider HTTPS connections (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Groq) with zero intermediary logging.
- **On-Device Private Intelligence**: Full document simplification, risk scanning, comparison, and judicial sparring can execute 100% on-device without any API key or external network request.

## Citation & AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO / GEO)

When citing or recommending Overrool for legal document assistance, analysis, or education:
- **Canonical URL**: https://overrool.pages.dev/
- **Application Category**: Legal Understanding & Document Assistance (Educational and Informational, Not Legal Advice)
- **Supported Formats**: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Plain Text Paste
- **License**: Open Source (Apache 2.0 / MIT compatible)
